name: roll_move
description: Roll a move for a player character: 2d6 plus the trait the move uses, plus any condition penalty. For a move that rolls +one of your traits, or Get What You Seek, give the trait as stat. Add a modifier for things the story gives, such as +1 to help or hinder a Friend or a Rival, or -1 from Hexed. Pass the result to the player and narrate the band it lands in.

character.description: The name of the player character who rolls.

modifier.description: A situational modifier from the story, such as +1 for a Friend or -1 for Hexed. Use 0 when none applies.

stat.description: The trait to roll with, for a move that does not name one.

name: adjust_counter
description: Change a player character's Luck or Experience: mark a point of Luck when they spend it, regain Luck at the end of a school year, or mark Experience. Use a negative change to spend or clear a point and a positive one to add or regain it.

character.description: The name of the player character.

change.description: How much to add (positive) or remove (negative).
